50900.meaning1: ruler of a province; governor of a small area
50900.commentary: (VINa) maṇḍalikā nāma ye dīpapadese'pi ekam'ekaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhuñjanti.

examples.text: rājāno nāma pathabyārājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mah'āmattā, ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṃ karontā anusāsanti. ete rājāno nāma.

50901.meaning2: belonging to a circle or a small country

examples.text: yo andhakāre tamasi pabhaṅ'karo, verocano maṇḍalī uggatejo. mā rāhu gilī caram'antalikkhe, pajaṃ mamaṃ rāhu pamuñca sūriyan'ti.
ucce maṇḍalipākāre, daḷham'aṭṭālakoṭṭhake, rakkhito khaggahatthehi, uttasaṃ vihariṃ pure.

ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate. atha kho upako maṇḍikāputto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho upako maṇḍikāputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sudhotarajapacchadaṃ subhaṃ, goṇakatūlikasanthataṃ navaṃ, abhiruha sayanaṃ mah'ārahaṃ, candanamaṇḍitasāragandhikaṃ.

50906.meaning2: state of being adorned; fact of being decorated

examples.text: saggaṃ nūna gamissanti, sabbe maṇḍūkakacchapā, nāgā ca susumārā ca, ye c'aññe udake carā.

atha kho milindo rājā khaggaparivārito viya gajo, garuḷaparivārito viya nāgo, ajagaraparivārito viya kotthuko, mahiṃsaparivuto viya accho, nāgānubaddho viya maṇḍūko, saddūl'ānubaddho viya migo, ahituṇḍikasamāgato viya pannago, majjārasamāgato viya undūro, bhūtavejjasamāgato viya pisāco… bhīto…

50909.meaning1: (gram) 'jumping' of a rule from one context to another

examples.text: appamādo amatapadaṃ, pamādo maccuno padaṃ, appamattā na mīyanti, ye pamattā yathā matā.
brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchā bhūmakā kāmaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā udak'orohakā aggiparicārakā. te mataṃ kālaṅ'kataṃ uyyāpenti nāma saññāpenti nāma saggaṃ nāma okkāmenti.
ambho purisa kiṃ tuyh'iminā pāpakena dujjīvitena, mataṃ te jīvitā seyyo'ti, iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya

ayaṃ pan'ettha aṭṭhakath'ācariyānaṃ mat'ānusārena vinicchayo, vuttañ'h'etaṃ ussadakittane (dha. sa. aṭṭha. 498) ime sattā pubbahetuniyāmena lobh'ussadā dos'ussadā moh'ussadā alobh'ussadā ados'ussadā amoh'ussadā ca honti.

50919.commentary: (MNt) matakabhatte'ti mate uddissa katabhatte. (ANt) matakabhattan'ti matake uddissa dātabbabhattaṃ, pitupiṇḍan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ath'assa mātāpitaro tattha tattha pariyesitvā apassantā roditvā paridevitvā, mato bhavissatī'ti matakabhattaṃ adaṃsu. sā ekaṃ takkasilagāmiṃ satthavāhaṃ disvā yānakassa pacchato pacchato anubandhi.

50923.commentary: (MNa) matajaṃ nāmā'ti manussā tikhiṇaṃ ayaṃ ayena sughaṃsitvā taṃ ayacuṇṇaṃ maṃsena saddhiṃ madditvā koñcasakuṇe khādāpenti. te uccāraṃ kātuṃ asakkontā maranti. no ce maranti, paharitvā mārenti. atha tesaṃ kucchiṃ phāletvā naṃ udakena dhovitvā cuṇṇaṃ gahetvā maṃsena saddhiṃ madditvā puna khādāpentī'ti evaṃ satta vāre khādāpetvā gahitena ayacuṇṇena āvudhaṃ karonti. susikkhitā ca naṃ ayakārā bahuhatthakammamūlaṃ labhitvā karonti. taṃ matasakuṇato jātattā matajan'ti vuccati, atitikhiṇaṃ hoti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.
vasitā susānamajjhe, atho'pi khāditāni puttamaṃsāni, hatakulikā sabbagarahitā, matapatikā amatam'adhigacchiṃ.

50926.meaning1: whose son has died; with a dead child
50926.commentary: (SNa) accantaṃ mataputtāmhī'ti ettha antaṃ atītaṃ accantaṃ, bhāvanapuṃsakam'etaṃ. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yathā puttamaraṇaṃ antaṃ atītaṃ hoti, evaṃ mataputtā ahaṃ, idāni mama puna puttamaraṇaṃ nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: kiṃ nu tvaṃ mataputtā'va, ekam'āsi rudammukhī, vanamajjhagatā ekā, purisaṃ nu gavesasī'ti.
accantaṃ mataputt'āmhi, purisā etadantikā, na socāmi na rodāmi, na taṃ bhāyāmi āvuso.

seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso ubhohi hatthehi vaṭṭakaṃ gāḷhaṃ gaṇheyya, so tatth'eva matam'eyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, acc'āraddhavīriyaṃ udapādi, acc'āraddhavīriy'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi.
vetāḷan'ti ghanatāḷaṃ, mantena matasarīr'uṭṭhāpanan'ti'pi eke.
paññāpāramitaṃ patto, mahābuddhi mahāmati, ajaḷo jaḷasamāno, sadā carati nibbuto.
yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅ'khaṇikāya'pi, saṅgh'ādiseso.
itthiyā vā purisamatin'ti purisassa matiṃ itthiyā āroceti.

50933.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, pañña, paññava, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, paṇḍita, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, vibhāvī, sapañña, sappañña
50933.commentary: (NIDD2) matimā'ti paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī. (SNPa) iti ñatvā matimā'ti evaṃ ñatvā buddhimā paṇḍito puriso sabbam'p'etaṃ pahāya eko care khaggavisāṇakappo'ti.

examples.text: idha, bhante, ekacco sacco c'assa saddho ca, na ca kuhako, na ca lapako, na ca nemittiko, na ca nippesiko, na ca lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanako, indriyesu guttadvāro, bhojane mattaññū, samakārī, jāgariy'ānuyogam'anuyutto, atandito, āraddhavīriyo, jhāyī, satimā, kalyāṇapaṭibhāno, gatimā, dhitimā, matimā, na ca kāmesu giddho, sato ca nipako ca. etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, purisasīlasamācāre.
vicinī aggahī dhovi, rajayī dhārayī muni, paṃsukūlāni matimā, anuruddho anāsavo.
[sumattikataṃ, ettha matisaddo kaṭṭhakhettassa samīkaraṇasādhane dārubhaṇḍe vattatī'ti sakkata-abhidhānesu āgataṃ. taṃ matiyā suṭṭhu samīkatan'ti aṭṭhakathāya sameti]
asāre sāramatino, sāre c'āsāradassino, te sāraṃ n'ādhigacchanti, micchāsaṅkappagocarā.
avajje vajjamatino, vajje c'āvajjadassino, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.

50937.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: sumbho subho matulo aṭṭhamo ca, ath'assumegho anīgho sudāṭho, paccekabuddhā bhavanettikhīṇā, hiṅgū ca hiṅgo ca mah'ānubhāvā.

50938.meaning1: amount of; as many as; measure of; consisting of

examples.text: paṇṇavīsativassāni, yato pabbajitā ahaṃ, n'āccharāsaṅghātamattam'pi, cittass'ūpasam'ajjhagaṃ.
savitakkasavicārā dhammā. avitakkavicāramattā dhammā. avitakk'āvicārā dhammā.

50939.meaning1: mere; simple; the fact of; by virtue of

examples.text: na vākkaraṇamattena, vaṇṇapokkharatāya vā, sādhurūpo naro hoti, issukī maccharī saṭho.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, jaṭilakassa jaṭādhāraṇamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.
evaṃ svākkhāte, bhikkhave, mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike yesaṃ mayi saddhāmattaṃ pemamattaṃ sabbe te saggaparāyanā'ti
tathāgate c'assa saddhāmattaṃ hoti pemamattaṃ, api c'assa ime dhammā honti

50941.commentary: (NIDD1) mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī'ti. sakāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhimānena matto pamatto ummatto atimatto'ti, mānena matto.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ yobbane yobbanamado, yena madena mattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.

50942.meaning1: (of an elephant) in musth; in rut; sexually inflamed; experiencing a testosterone surge

examples.text: tathā tu kassāmi yathā'pi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tena'pi hotu me alaṃ, vīriyena taṃ mayha vas'ānayissaṃ, gajaṃ'va mattaṃ kusal'aṅkusaggaho.
yogīpītikaraṃ rammaṃ, mattakuñjarasevitaṃ, eko attavasī khippaṃ, pavisissāmi kānanaṃ.

50943.synonym: attamana, abhiraddha, āmodita, patīta, pamudita, pamodita, pahaṃsita, pīṇita, rata, vitta, sampahaṃsita, sammudita, sukhita
50943.commentary: (ANa) sitaṃ sitamattāyā'ti tasmiṃ sitakāraṇe sati yaṃ sitaṃ karotha, taṃ vo sitamattāya aggadante dassetvā pahaṭṭh'ākāra-matta-dassanāya'y'eva yuttan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, setughāto gīte, setughāto nacce, alaṃ vo dhammappamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyā'ti.

50944.commentary: (THIa) mattā vaṇṇena rūpenā'ti guṇavaṇṇena c'eva rūpasampattiyā ca.

examples.text: mattā vaṇṇena rūpena, sobhaggena yasena ca, yobbanena c'upatthaddhā, aññāsam'atimaññi'haṃ.
siyā kho pana, bhante, idh'ekaccassa āyasmato evam'assa, kevalaṃ saddhāmattakaṃ nūna ayam'āyasmā nissāya nekkhamm'ādhimutto'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, bhante, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
evarūpassa puggalassa tādisaṃ'y'eva appamattakaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, n'āṇu'pi khāyati, kiṃ bahu'd'eva.

50947.meaning1: for the purpose of; used for

50948.meaning1: having the size of; as big as
50948.meaning2: having the size of; as big as

examples.text: evam'eva pan'udāyi, idh'ekacce moghapurisā idaṃ pajahathā'ti mayā vuccamānā te evam'āhaṃsu, kiṃ pan'imassa appamattakassa oramattakassa adhisallikhat'ev'āyaṃ samaṇo'ti.

50949.meaning1: elephant in musth; elephant experiencing a testosterone surge

examples.text: yogīpītikaraṃ rammaṃ, mattakuñjarasevitaṃ, eko attavasī khippaṃ, pavisissāmi kānanaṃ.

50950.meaning1: moderation (in); knowing the correct amount (of); temperance (in)

examples.text: anūpavādo anūpaghāto, pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro, mattaññutā ca bhattasmiṃ, pantañ'ca sayan'āsanaṃ, adhicitte ca āyogo, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
na kamm'ārāmatā, na bhass'ārāmatā, na nidd'ārāmatā, na saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, asaṃsagg'ārāmatā, nippapañc'ārāmatā.

50951.meaning1: knowing the correct measure; knowing the limit; moderate (in)
50951.meaning2: knowing the measure or limit, moderate

examples.text: asubh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu susaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi ca mattaññuṃ, saddhaṃ āraddhavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve nappasahati māro, vāto selaṃ'va pabbataṃ.
bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya

50952.meaning1: short-lived; brief-standing; remaining only for a short time
50952.commentary: (MNa) mattaṭṭhakassā'ti parittaṭṭhitikassa, tattha dvīh'ākārehi imassa kāyassa parittaṭṭhititā veditabbā ṭhitiparittatāya ca sarasaparittatāya ca.

examples.text: kiṃ pan'imassa mattaṭṭhakassa kāyassa taṇh'upādinnassa ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā? atha khv'āssa no't'ev'ettha hoti.

50953.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc of mattaṭṭhiya
50953.commentary: (THa) matt'aṭṭhiyan'ti taṃ mattaṃ payojanaṃ. yāva'd'eva sītavātaparittāṇaṃ, yāva'd'eva hirīkopīnapaṭicchādanaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ paribhuñjiṃsu.

examples.text: sītavātaparittānaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itarītare.

50954.meaning1: knows the limit; understands the boundary; recognizes the line
50954.commentary: (SNa) na v'āyaṃ kumārako mattam'aññāsī'ti ayaṃ kumārako attano pamāṇaṃ na jānātī'ti theraṃ tajjento āha.

examples.text: atha kho, pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāg'āpalokitaṃ apalokesi, na v'āyaṃ dūsī māro mattam'aññāsī'ti. sah'āpalokanāya ca pana, pāpima, dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi mahānirayañ'ca upapajji.

50955.commentary: (PMa) matthaluṅgaṃ sīsakaṭāh'abbhantare cattāro sibbinimagge nissāya ṭhito catupiṇḍasamodhāno miñjarāsi.

50956.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of mattā (+gen)
50956.meaning1: with measure (of); moderately; to a moderate degree

examples.text: yassa kho, bhikkhave, ime dhammā evaṃ paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti, ayaṃ vuccati dhamm'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattaso kārī paññāya mattaso kārī.

50959.commentary: (DNa) pakati kho esā'ti pakatikathā esā. imāya ca, kassapa, mattāyā'ti kassapa yadi iminā pamāṇena evaṃ parittakena paṭipattikkamena sāmaññaṃ vā brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ nāma abhavissa, tato n'etaṃ abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya dukkaraṃ sāmaññan'ti ayam'ettha padasambandhena saddhiṃ attho. etena nayena sabbattha padasambandho veditabbo.

examples.text: imāya ca, kassapa, mattāya iminā tapopakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā abhavissa brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ, n'etaṃ abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya, dukkaraṃ sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ brahmaññan'ti.
sītavātaparittāṇaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itar'ītare.

50962.grammar: fem, dat sg of mattā, in comps (+gen)
50962.meaning1: for a measure; for a modicum; for a sufficient amount (of)

examples.text: atthi kāyo'ti vā pan'assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati
byañjanaṃ kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo byañjanamattāya āhāreti, na ca byañjanena ālopaṃ atināmeti.
mattāsukhapariccāgā, passe ce vipulaṃ sukhaṃ, caje mattāsukhaṃ dhīro, sampassaṃ vipulaṃ sukhaṃ.
na c'āhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brūmi, yonijaṃ mattisambhavaṃ, bhovādi nāma so hoti, sace hoti sakiñcano, akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

50965.meaning1: maternal; coming from one's mother; belonging to the mother
50965.meaning2: maternal; came form mother; belonging to a mother
50965.commentary: (MNa) mattikan'ti mātito āgataṃ, idaṃ te mātāmahiyā mātu imaṃ gehaṃ āgacchantiyā gandhamāl'ādīnaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ dhanan'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa pitā taṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇassa puñjaṃ vivarāpetvā āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ etadavoca, idaṃ te, tāta raṭṭhapāla, mātu mattikaṃ dhanaṃ, aññaṃ pettikaṃ, aññaṃ pitāmahaṃ.
yathā'pi kumbhakārassa, kataṃ mattikabhājanaṃ, khuddakañ'ca mahantañ'ca, yañ'ca pakkaṃ yañ'ca āmakaṃ, sabbaṃ bhedapariyantaṃ, evaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ tiṇaṃ vā mattikaṃ vā siñceyya vā siñcāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṭṭhañ'ca paṭicca valliñ'ca paṭicca tiṇañ'ca paṭicca mattikañ'ca paṭicca ākāso parivārito agāraṃ tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati
patirūpako mattikākuṇḍalo'va, loh'aḍḍhamāso'va suvaṇṇachanno, caranti loke parivārachannā, anto asuddhā bahi sobhamānā'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso imaṃ mahāpathaviṃ kolaṭṭhimattaṃ kolaṭṭhimattaṃ mattikāguḷikaṃ karitvā nikkhipeyya, ayaṃ me pitā, tassa me pitu ayaṃ pitā'ti, apariyādinnā'va bhikkhave, tassa purisassa pitupitaro assu, ath'āyaṃ mahāpathavī parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.

50971.commentary: (THa) aggahiṃ mattikāpattan'ti evarūpe mahārahe bhājane pubbe bhuñjitvā buddhānaṃ ovādaṃ karonto idān'āhaṃ taṃ chaḍḍetvā mattikāmayapattaṃ aggahesiṃ

examples.text: hitvā satapalaṃ kaṃsaṃ, sovaṇṇaṃ satarājikaṃ, aggahiṃ mattikāpattaṃ, idaṃ dutiy'ābhisecanan'ti.
patto nāma dve pattā ayopatto mattikāpatto'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.
adaḍḍhā'pi vuccati jātā pathavī. yo'pi paṃsupuñjo vā mattikāpuñjo vā atirekacātumāsaṃ ovaṭṭho, ayam'pi vuccati jātā pathavī.

50975.commentary: (VINa) mattikābhaṇḍam'pi rajanabhājan'ādi sabbaṃ tattha vuttappabhedam'eva. taṃ sabbaṃ aggisālāya vā aññatarasmiṃ vā guttaṭṭhāne paṭisāmetvā gantabbaṃ. anovassake pabbhāre'pi ṭhapetuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: so mā cintayitthā'ti vatvā na taṇḍulehī'ti kaṇikaṃ gāhāpetvā, na udakenā'ti himaṃ gāhāpetvā, na ukkhaliyā'ti aññaṃ navamattikābhājanaṃ gāhāpetvā, na uddhanenā'ti khāṇuke koṭṭāpetvā, na agginā'ti pakati-aggiṃ pahāya araṇi-aggiṃ gāhāpetvā, na dārūhī'ti paṇṇāni gāhāpetvā ambil'odanaṃ pacāpetvā

udakavāhako'ti nadīpūro. mātā'pi puttaṃ paṭilabhatī'ti kulle vā uḷumpe vā mattikābhājane vā dārukkhaṇḍe vā laggaṃ vuyhamānaṃ passituṃ paṭilabhati, sotthinā vā puna uttaritvā gāme vā araññe vā ṭhitaṃ passituṃ labhatī'ti.
na c'āhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brūmi, yonijaṃ mattisambhavaṃ, bhovādi nāma so hoti, sace hoti sakiñcano, akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

50980.meaning1: honouring one's mother; respecting one's mother
50980.commentary: (SNa) matteyyā'ti mātuhitā, mātari sammāpaṭipannā'ti attho. petteyyādīsu pituhitā petteyyā. (PVa) matteyyā'ti mātuhitā.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye matteyyā, atha kho et'eva bahutarā sattā ye amatteyyā.
matteyyā hotha petteyyā, kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyikā, sāmaññā hotha brahmaññā, evaṃ saggaṃ gamissathā'ti.

50981.meaning1: love for one's mother; filial piety

examples.text: sukhā matteyyatā loke, atho petteyyatā sukhā, sukhā sāmaññatā loke, atho brahmaññatā sukhā.
seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso navanīt'atthiko navanītagavesī navanītapariyesanaṃ caramāno udakaṃ kalase āsiñcitvā matthena āviñcheyya.
seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo punavirūḷhiyā
sattiyā viya omaṭṭho, ḍayhamāno'va matthake, kāmarāgappahānāya, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.

so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti

50989.meaning1: with crown cut off; with head removed

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, pāpima, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna virūḷhiyā, evam'eva kho, pāpima, tathāgatassa ye āsavā saṃkilesikā… te pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā'ti.

50990.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of matthaka (+gen)

examples.text: atthi deva ito vīsatiyojanasatamatthake sāvatthima nagaraṃ tato āgacchāmā'ti

50991.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of matthaka (+gen & +abl)

examples.text: ayaṃ buddhattāya abhinīhāraṃ katvā nipanno, samijjhissati imassa patthanā, ito kappasatasahass'ādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake gotamo nāma buddho bhavissati.

50992.commentary: (PMa) matthaluṅgaṃ sīsakaṭāh'abbhantare cattāro sibbinimagge nissāya ṭhito catupiṇḍasamodhāno miñjarāsi.

examples.text: atthi imasmiṃ kāye… antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ (matthaluṅgaṃ), pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan'ti.
sattamaṃ divasaṃ seṭṭhissa gahapatissa matthaluṅgaṃ pariyādiyissati. matthaluṅgassa pariyādānā seṭṭhi gahapati kālaṃ karissati. sudiṭṭho tehi ācariyehī'ti.

50993.meaning1: these are my; this is my

examples.text: puttā m'atthi dhanam'm'atthi, iti bālo vihaññati, attā hi attano n'atthi, kuto puttā kuto dhanaṃ.
ahaṃ tava vas'ānugo siyaṃ, yadi viharemase kānan'antare, na hi m'atthi tayā piyattaro, pāṇo kinnarimandalocane.
502, 493. yamhi dā dhā mā ṭhā hā pā maha math'ādīnam'ī.
yamhi paccaye pare dā dhā mā ṭhā hā pā maha matha icc'evam'ādīnaṃ dhātūnaṃ anto īkāram'āpajjate. dīyati, dhīyati, mīyati, ṭhīyati, hīyati, pīyati, mahīyati, mathīyati.
